title: SWF compile: text field restrict property not emitted
description: The text field model may have a restrict property (limits character input e.g. '0-9A-Z'), but compile.ts and text.ts never emit it. In SWF, DefineEditText has no built-in restrict field — it must be set via AS2 initialization code: tf.restrict = '...' in a DoAction script. Fix: in compile.ts, after placing a text field with a restrict value, emit a DoAction with AS2: instanceName.restrict = restrictPattern. Requires the text field to have an instanceName set. Low priority — uncommon in typical Flash 8 content.
